We Provide The Best Logistic & Trading Services For Your Needs

By choosing AL MIRZAM GROUP, you're not just getting a logistics provider; you're gaining a reliable partner dedicated to optimizing your global trade operations.

Dubai Trade & Mirsal 2

Customs Clearance Expertise

Ensure a smooth and hassle-free customs clearance process with our team of experienced professionals. We navigate the complexities of UAE customs regulations, minimizing delays and demurrage.

  • Import, Export, Transit & Free Zone Declarations
  • HS Code Classification & Duty/FTA Advisory
  • Dubai Municipality, MOIAT & Chamber Attestations
DXB & DWC Hubs

Air Freight Solutions

Choose our air freight services for fast and reliable transportation of your goods. Strategic partnerships with leading air carriers at DXB and DWC guarantee timely delivery and efficiency.

  • Priority Next-Flight-Out & Consolidated Air
  • Sea-Air Multimodal Connections via Dubai
  • AWB Documentation & Airport Customs Release
FCL & LCL Worldwide

Ocean Freight Management

Optimize your shipping costs with our comprehensive ocean freight services. From Bill of Lading documentation to container tracking at Jebel Ali and Port Rashid, we handle every sea freight need.

  • 20ft, 40ft & 40ft HC Full Container Load (FCL)
  • LCL Consolidation, Reefer & Breakbulk Cargo
  • Port-to-Port & Door-to-Door Global Ocean Lanes

Road Transport & GCC Fleet

UAE & GCC

Reliable Full Truckload (FTL) and Less than Truckload (LTL) overland fleets serving all seven Emirates and cross-border GCC corridors (Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, Bahrain, and Iraq).

  • Port-to-Warehouse Container Haulage
  • Cross-Border GCC Bonded Trucking & Exit/Entry
  • Flatbed, Box, Curtain-Sider & Reefer Trailers

Import & Export Consulting

Trade Advisory

End-to-end regulatory advisory for UAE importers, exporters, and international traders—covering customs importer code setup, FTA compliance, Certificate of Origin, and LC documentation.

  • Dubai Customs Code & Dubai Trade Registration
  • Duty Exemption, Makasa & Temporary Admission
  • Regulatory Permits (FIRs, MOIAT, Excise/FTA)

Customized Logistics & Wholesale

Tailored Supply Chain
